name: new_bank_v2_single_reference_force_calibration
primary_arm: F0v2; frozen by the zero-shot parent validation selection
prototype: one or two Medium native target trials per gesture, in source-scaled feature coordinates, shared across all ten evaluation conditions
source_fit: same source-only F0v2/F2a feature state, StandardScaler and balanced LogisticRegression C=1 as parent
temperature: median source-trial mean-squared distance to source-class centroid, minimum 1e-6
fusion: fixed 0.5 source logistic plus 0.5 softmax negative prototype mean-squared distances divided by source-only temperature
burden_motivation: per-condition 1/2-shot calibration needs 70/140 trials (about 211/423 seconds recorded signal per user); this single-reference protocol needs 7/14 trials (about 21/42 seconds)
selection: Medium reference, arms, budgets, evaluation trials and 0.5 weight fixed before outcomes; no final-user tuning
endpoint: matched pooled/subject/condition macro-F1, log loss, Brier and worst-condition F1; compare against per-condition parent on identical evaluation trials
boundary: public eight-channel 1000 Hz instructed intensity; manually labelled reference gestures; recorded signal duration excludes setup/transitions; no own-device or live claim
